Math problem: 400 liters flow into the pool, 405 flow out. Question: do the swimmers have any shame?

***

— Your surname?
— Fart.
— What?
— Not 'what', Fart.

— Beauty, marry me!
— And what will you give me?
— Half my kingdom!
— No... half a kingdom is way too much to clean. How about a small apartment instead?
— Look at her — now she wants the whole kingdom!

A drunk guy stumbles through the park. Out of nowhere — a moose charges straight at him. Wham! He gets up: "What the...?!"
Barely on his feet — a bear slams into him. Down again. Gets up: "What is going on?!" Then a rabbit comes flying at him. He thinks: a rabbit, how bad can it be... Nope — flat on the ground again.
And then a voice from above: "Hey buddy, maybe step away from the merry-go-round!"

A cop spots an old lady hauling two heavy bags — a wad of cash falls out of one. He stops her:
"Where'd all that money come from?"
"Behind my garden there's a golf course. Players come up to the fence and stick their... through a gap to water my flowers. Ruins them, it does. So I started keeping watch — the moment anyone pokes through, I grab on tight and say: 'Pay up or it comes off!' Filled a whole bag that way."
"Well, fair enough. What's in the other bag?"
"Not everyone pays..."

Guys, did I get busted! My wife was away on a month-long business trip and came back a day early. She walks in — soup in the fridge, floors gleaming, flowers watered... 'You spent your whole life saying you can't do housework — turns out you can?!' she snaps. 'I always had to do everything myself!' I try to explain: it wasn't me, I had women over. She doesn't believe it. Because when she walked in the door, I was standing at the sink washing the dishes.

At the wedding, the bride quietly slipped something into her father's hand. The guests noticed and held their breath — what had she given him? The father felt every pair of eyes on him. He paused, then solemnly raised his hand and declared: 'Ladies and gentlemen, I hereby declare this the happiest day of my life!' He grinned and added: 'My daughter has finally returned my credit card!' The hall burst into laughter. Everyone laughed... except the groom.

A 40-year-old man had been job hunting for half a year. He sent resumes, made calls — silence every time. He finally went in person to an employer and asked:
— Tell me, I've been rejected fifteen times now. Am I doing something wrong? Is my resume bad?
The employer smiled:
— No, your resume is excellent. It's just that you're forty, smart and experienced — there's no way we can cheat you on salary.

A drunk staggers into church during the service and slaps the priest across the face:
— Turn the other cheek! Go on, turn it!
The priest calmly answers with a right hook:
— With the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.
A crowd gathers and watches with great interest. A cop rushes in:
— What's going on here?!
The crowd: Don't interrupt — they're studying the Gospel.

A burglar breaks into a house — there's a parrot in the corner. It immediately squawks: "Kesha sees everything!" The burglar throws a towel over the cage. Silence. Then from under the towel: "Just so you know... I'm not Kesha. Kesha is the bulldog."

The English teacher writes a sentence on the board for the class to translate. She's nervous — the school inspector is sitting right next to the class troublemaker. The chalk slips from her fingers; she bends down to pick it up… All the boys crane their necks. The inspector mutters something under his breath.

"Now, who can translate the sentence?" asks the teacher.

The troublemaker leaps up and starts his "translation":
"With a backside like that, she shouldn't be working at a school — she should be working in a..."

"Get out of my classroom!" the teacher shouts.

On his way out, the boy turns back to the inspector:
"You old goat — if you don't know the answer yourself, don't go whispering hints!"

One farmer stopped by his neighbor's place.
— "Hey, why is your rooster wearing pants?"
— "My wife accidentally poured boiling water on him — his backside went completely bald. We sewed him little trousers so he wouldn't freeze."
— "And his feathers still haven't grown back?"
— "Oh, they grew back ages ago! But it's just too funny watching him hold the hen with one claw and pull his pants down with the other!"

— Once I got stranded on a deserted island. After days of hunger and loneliness, I heard a plane approaching. I grabbed dry branches, spelled out HELP, and set them on fire.
— And? Did they save you?
— No. The letter H didn't catch fire. From up above it just said "ELP"...

Wife: "Go buy some eggs."
Husband (glued to the TV): "I've got two eggs right here. Will those do?"
Wife: "Can you eat them?"
Husband: "Can't eat them — but you can lick them!"
Wife: "Perfect. Then lick them yourself for breakfast tomorrow morning."

A class reunion 38 years later — and everything becomes immediately clear.
The D-student has two things: an apartment and a car.
The C-student has three: an apartment, a car, and a vacation home.
The honor student has five: glasses, debt, a bald spot, chronic migraines, and a gold medal made of stainless steel.

— My wife earns more than me and pays for everything — groceries, bills, all of it.
— Come on, a man is supposed to be the provider!
— I AM the provider. I provided myself with this incredible woman — and I'm not complaining.

Some beginner mushroom pickers got lost in the woods and survived for two days eating wild mushrooms. When rescuers finally found them, their accounts didn't match. Not just the details — they couldn't even agree on the century.

A husband comes home from the market with eggs — dirty and tiny. His wife starts yelling. He takes the eggs to the bathroom to wash them. She follows, still nagging.
The phone rings. Their kid picks up:
— Is Dad home?
— Dad's in the bathroom washing eggs!
— And Mom?
— Mom's in there too — gnawing on Dad's eggs!

— Dad, buy me a new iPhone!
— Do you know the magic word?
— Tanya.
— Tanya? What's that supposed to mean?
— Your girlfriend's name. Oh, and I'll need a case to go with it.

— Does it bother you being left-handed?
— Not at all. Everyone has their quirks. Which hand do you use to stir your tea?
— My right hand.
— Huh. Normal people use a spoon.

— Hey, fancy going out for a drink?
— No, I've sworn off alcohol.
— Why?
— Well, yesterday I came home, had a shower, wrapped myself in a towel, grabbed a bottle of cognac, sat on the windowsill and started watching the street.
— And?
— And then I somehow ended up in three nightclubs wearing just that towel.

Husband and wife in bed one evening. Wife:
— Honey, I already know, but I just want to hear it again: do you love me?
— How much?
— Four thousand dollars. A genuine crocodile leather handbag.
— Fine.
Five minutes later, the husband:
— Babe, you remember everything I always tell you — that you're the most beautiful, smartest, and most incredible woman in the world?
— How much?
— Three days, sweetheart. Just a little fishing trip, I'll be back.

A man suggests a game: "Guess the Profession!"
— Mine starts with E and ends with R — Engineer! What about yours?
— Mine starts with C and ends in T.
The man goes silent, stunned.
— My profession is Chemist. What you were thinking? That's just a hobby...

A husband and wife are chatting:
— Do you know what "variety" means?
— Well... tell me.
— It means Ashley, Brittany, Megan, Kate...
— Oh, I get it — like Mike, Tyler, Josh...
— (interrupts her) No! Honey, don't confuse having connections with having variety!

His wife sent him to get crayfish. On the way he ran into some buddies and vanished for two days. When he finally made it home, he had no idea what to say — so he dumped the crayfish right in front of the door. His wife opens it, and he nudges them with his foot:
— Well, we finally made it! Come on in, come on in...

Two friends are drinking. The booze runs out and they're flat broke. The host says:
— Hang on, I'll print some cash.
Sure enough, there's a printing press in the next room. They print some bills, run to the shop, and keep the party going.
Next day the host gets called in by the police.
— Are you counterfeiting money?
— Not at all. I just put the bills in the machine beforehand, and it smooths out the creases.
— And why do you do that?
— To find out who's worth drinking with.
In a happy family, the husband makes all the decisions. His wife just explains which ones.

— Doctor, are you serious?! Why did you prescribe me to shove a bouquet of violets up my backside?!
— My dear fellow, it won't matter to you anymore. But our pathologist Tanya has a birthday tomorrow — she'll appreciate it.

A husband and wife are riding a train. For three straight hours, the wife hasn't stopped nagging. The husband steps out to smoke — his compartment neighbor follows.
"You know, your wife is a classic neurotic. I'm a psychiatrist. Come see me — $500 and I'll have her sorted out within a week."
"Thanks, but we're heading to Kazan. They'll shoot her there for just $100."

My boyfriend introduced me to his family, but warned me first: his mom is a language and literature teacher who is fanatically strict about proper speech — no swearing, no filler words whatsoever. All evening she winced every time I said 'shoot' or 'dang,' and on the way out she hinted she would 'work on my manners.' I didn't take it seriously. Until, at the door, her husband — a big guy in his fifties with decades in construction — slipped on wet snow and crashed flat into a puddle. All he said was: 'What an unfortunate mishap!' Now I'm afraid of her.

An old man goes to the doctor:
— Doctor, I have a strange problem — when I pass gas, there's no sound and no smell. Is that normal?
The doctor examines him, prescribes some pills, and tells him to come back in a week.
A week later, the old man returns:
— Doctor, what have you done?! Still no sound, but now the smell is absolutely awful!
— Perfect, grandpa! — says the doctor. — We've fixed your nose. Now let's work on your ears!

A professor asks his students:
— Imagine you have two houses. One — a magnificent mansion. The other — a tiny cottage where your girlfriend lives. Which do you choose?
— Student: The mansion!
— Professor: What if she tells you she's madly in love with you?
— Student: Still the mansion.
— Professor: What if she swears you're the love of her life and she can't live without you?
— Student (hesitating): …The mansion.
— Professor: What if she also lives completely alone, deep in the woods, no family, no neighbors, and nobody knows where she is?
— Student (jumping up): Wait — that's my wife! The mansion, obviously!

— Dad, I got a flat tire!
— Honey, you're married — call your husband, let him deal with it.
— I called him, he's not picking up...
— Don't you have a spare?
— He's not answering either.

Two lovers are in bed when suddenly the doorbell rings. The lover jumps into the wardrobe but doesn't quite make it — his balls end up sticking out. The husband bursts in: "Honey, get me something to eat fast — the football final's about to start!" "There are dumplings in the kitchen, help yourself." He grabs a plate, races to the TV, trips, and scatters them all over the floor. He collects them up — then suddenly a wild yelp. "What happened?!" "Got them all... but two were stuck to the wardrobe. Tried to get them off with a fork — and they told me where to go!"

A husband decided to test his wife. He pretended to leave for work and hid under the bed. The wife brought her lover over; they lay down. She said: "I want to have a baby with you!" — "Really? You don't even know how to swaddle a newborn!" To prove him wrong, she tightly wrapped the lover in a blanket and went to the kitchen for a pacifier. The husband crawled out from under the bed, leaned over the bundled-up man and cooed softly: "Goo-goo! Gooo-goo!" Then he calmly walked to the kitchen and told his wife: "You'd better re-wrap your little one — he had an accident!"

An Arab sheikh is visiting Warsaw. From his car he spots a woman waiting in a long grocery line and tells his assistant:
— I like that woman. Go talk to her.
The assistant approaches:
— The sheikh has noticed you. You could be his favourite wife in the harem and live like in paradise.
The woman replies:
— Tell your sheikh: I've been standing in lines all day long. The last thing I need is to queue up for a man too!

Three men come to court a girl: a Russian, a Frenchman, and a German. The Russian brings a daisy — she asks him to eat it, he does. The Frenchman arrives with a rose, she says: "Eat it." He eats it, crying and laughing at the same time. She asks:
— Why are you crying?
— The thorns are sharp!
— Why are you laughing?
— Because the German is bringing a cactus!

A wife texts her husband: 'Can't make it to the store, pick up a chicken for dinner.' He replies: 'Breast?' She's floored — 8 years of marriage and he's suddenly being naughty! She writes back: 'Honey, I love you so much, you cheeky thing...' He: 'Idiot, I'm asking — chicken breast or thighs?!'

An artist goes to confession.
— What is your sin, my son?
— I'm living with a painting, Father.
— What do you mean?
— I painted a full-length nude beauty, cut a hole in the canvas, and hide my housekeeper behind it.
The priest stroked his beard and replied thoughtfully:
— Your sin is great, my son… but the idea is quite good.

A police officer stops a student on a bike and asks for his ID.
— So, we don't have a job, do we...
— No, we don't.
— So, we're living off government money...
— Yes, we are.
— So, we're a student...
— Well, on that last one — sorry, only I am the student.

A sergeant takes 4 soldiers outside the base for a work detail. Afterwards he lines them up and counts: one, two, three, four. "There were five of us — where's the fifth? Dismissed, go find him!" Ten minutes later, same story. After the third time, a soldier says: "Sergeant, let me count — you get in line." He counts: "One, two, three, four..." then points to himself: "Five!" The sergeant walks over and smacks him on the head: "So YOU'RE the one we've been looking for this whole time, you idiot!"

A man has been sitting in the bathtub staring at a fishing float for three hours. His wife finally snaps:
— Fine, go to your fishing already! I need to do laundry.

When she came back with a beer, turned on the football, and started undressing, the husband realized: the car was never getting fixed.

An officer comes home. His wife meets him at the door:
— I heard your unit is being disbanded?
— What nonsense! Where did you hear that?!
— Old Margaret at the market told me.
— Complete rubbish! The unit stands and will keep standing. I'm the commander — I know better than anyone!
The next day he comes home:
— Honey, pop down to the market... ask Margaret where they're transferring me.

A woman calls her lover:
— Honey, I left my underwear in your car yesterday. What if your wife finds them! Did you find them?
— I did. Why didn't you warn me right away?
— Hold on… what if they're not mine?

An old man is on his deathbed. He calls his wife over:
— Listen, we have ten sons. Nine of them look exactly alike. But the tenth is completely different. Tell me honestly — did you ever cheat on me?
— Yes, I did...
— Then tell me — who is the father of that tenth one?

A man drank himself to death. He ended up in heaven. God looked at him, unsure what to do.
— I still want to live — send me back! — the man pleaded.
— As a human I can't. But as a chicken — sure!
The man thought about it and agreed. He woke up in a henhouse, pecking at grain. Suddenly he felt pressure. He strained — an egg popped out! He liked it. Strained again — another egg! Then his wife burst in yelling:
— Get up, you drunk! You've made a total mess of the bed!

— Hey, what if we target the transpeptidase levels with some methylcarbinol?
— You moron! You're just asking if I want to go drinking?

A guy met a pretty girl — they spent the night together. Next morning she says:
— Honey, it was lovely, but mom and I have a gynecologist appointment today — a virginity check...
The guy opened a beer, pulled the rubber ring off the bottle cap, placed it where it needed to go, and relaxed.
At the doctor's, the girl settled into the chair. The doctor took a look — and froze.
— Well, doctor, is she still a virgin?! — the mother demanded.
— She is! But I've never seen an expiration date stamped here before!

A man goes to the doctor:
— Every time I start plowing the field with my tractor, I get... aroused.
Doctor:
— Take a rifle with you. When it happens — fire a shot. Your wife will come running, and the two of you can...
Six months later, the man is back at the doctor:
— Summer was fantastic, but now it's autumn and I can't find my wife anywhere!
— Why not?
— Hunting season started. There are gunshots going off everywhere.

A cunning woman seduces a billionaire and brings him to a luxury penthouse. After a wild night, she gently places her hand on his stomach and whispers:
— So... what shall we name our son?
He calmly ties a tight knot in the condom and replies:
— If he makes it out — we'll call him Alexander.

At a carpet store:
— I need something for the kids' room — ideally easy to clean.
— How many children do you have?
— Seven.
— Honestly, you'd be better off just paving the floor with asphalt.

A husband suspected his wife of cheating — constant texts and calls from some guy named Alex. He told her he was going on a business trip, then rented an apartment across the street and settled in with binoculars.

Soon a fancy car pulled up. Out stepped a fit, well-dressed guy with flowers. He went up to the wife's place. The husband watched: champagne, then straight to the bedroom. They undressed. Alex was stunning — biceps, six-pack, the full package.

Then the wife undressed... Sagging, belly rolls, cellulite.

The husband put down the binoculars and quietly said:
— Lord... I feel so sorry for Alex.

— Things didn't go so well with my girlfriend last night.
— Ha! What, did your hard drive suddenly go soft?
— No. She's a total comedian. The moment I walked in, she blinked twice and said: "New device detected." I froze for five minutes, then laughed for half an hour.

A man comes home from hunting, beaming with pride.
"How was the hunt?" asks his wife.
"Fantastic! I shot a whole pile of hedgehogs!"
"Are you out of your mind? What on earth are they good for?!"
"What do you mean? For you — a fur collar. For your mother — shoe insoles."

Mom is cooking in the kitchen when she hears her son playing trains in his room:
— Passengers, come on already! Get to your seats and clear your bags from the aisle — the train is about to depart!
Mom walks in and says firmly:
— Kiryusha, corner — now! Two hours to think about your behavior!
Two hours later, from behind the door:
— Dear passengers! Our train departs in five minutes. Please take your seats and remove your bags from the aisle. As for the reason behind the two-hour delay — please direct your questions to the lady in the kitchen.

On a work trip, the guys decided to prank a colleague — they slipped a pack of condoms into his suitcase before the journey home. His wife unpacks it and finds them. A long, loaded silence. He doesn't miss a beat: "Yeah, they handed them out to everyone — I just didn't use mine." The whole office block was in chaos for a week. Wives interrogating their husbands: "SO WHERE ARE YOURS???"

At the store I grab some toilet paper and drop it in my basket. Someone behind me asks:
— Is it soft?
— Oh, incredibly soft! I say enthusiastically.
The voice continues:
— Last time I bought some, I scraped myself completely raw...
Me:
— Do you really use it that often?
I turn around — and the guy is feeling up a toothbrush. The cashier nearly fell over laughing.

A woman gives birth to a redheaded baby and desperately begs the doctor to come up with some explanation — there isn't a single redhead in either her or her husband's family. The doctor calls the husband in and asks sternly:
— How often do you and your wife have sex?
— Well... about once every two months...
— There's your answer — look what you've done with that rusty tool of yours!
Positive thinking is when you tumble down the stairs and think: "Wow, that was fast!"

— How did you end up here?
— My wife threw me out...
— I see, but jumping from the second floor over it seems a bit much.
— Doctor, you're not getting it. She LITERALLY threw me out. Through the window.

My wife decided to give the whole family deworming pills 'just as a precaution' — she was bursting with enthusiasm. She dosed me, the kids, and herself, then went to bed quite pleased with herself. There happened to be leftover pasta from dinner... So I slipped a few noodles under her feet and a couple onto her pillow. You should have heard the screams!

A guy wakes up and sees his neighbor has a giant tennis court in the yard. He asks:
— Where did that come from?
The neighbor explains:
— There's a goldfish in the pond that grants any wish. But she's hard of hearing — you have to shout.
The guy runs to the pond and yells:
— Fish, I want lots of bucks!
Next morning he wakes up — the whole house is packed with ducks. He runs to his neighbor:
— I asked for lots of bucks and ended up with a house full of ducks!
The neighbor:
— I told you, she doesn't hear well. You think I asked for big tennis?!

A bear was trudging through the forest when he stopped to rest. A moose stepped out and said:
— Hey, flatfoot — do you know why they call you "Teddy"?
— Because I'm big, fluffy, and love honey?
— No — because you're the only animal in the forest brave enough to headbutt me and still tell it like it is!
The bear smiled:
— And do you know why everyone calls you "Antlers"?
— Why?
— Because that's the only thing on you that ever grew properly!

A newcomer is brought into a prison cell. Without a word, he walks around and flicks everyone on the nose:
— Plink, plink, plink!
The cellmates snap out of their daze:
— We'll beat you senseless — all of us!
— Won't work — I'm an alien, I have no reproductive organs.
— Prove it!
He shows them — and sure enough, completely smooth.
— Then how do you... you know... do it?
— Like this! Plink, plink, plink!

— Jen, how do you feel about crystalline carbon?
— What are you even talking about?! Stop showing off your brain!
— Got it. Crossing the diamond ring off the list, then.

A man walks through the market and spots an old vendor selling apple seeds — five dollars each.
"Gramps, have you lost your mind? Who pays five bucks for a single apple seed?"
"Ah, son, these are SMART seeds! Eat one and your brain kicks into gear instantly!"
Out of curiosity, the man buys one, chews it… then freezes:
"Wait a second, old man… For five dollars I could've bought a whole bag of apples — with at least twenty seeds inside!"
The old man grins slyly:
"See? You're already getting smarter!"
"You're right! Give me five more!"

Wife comes home from the New Year's office party, quietly slips off her coat and boots...
— Honey, please don't shout. I'll tell you everything: everyone was drinking — I wasn't, everyone was kissing — not me. Had some salad, danced a little, joined the games — then straight home. Your wife is a perfect angel. Any questions?
— Just one. Where's your dress?

Two neighbors are sitting on a bench outside their building. A third one comes out and starts complaining:
— Everything hurts! My arms, my legs, I can barely move...
— Oh, stop lying! — they reply. — Yesterday two men left your apartment, and this morning there was already another one.
— God, people are so mean. I've got one healthy part left — and they're already jealous!
I finally decided to do morning workouts — abs exercises. Set the alarm, got up at 6 AM, lay down on the floor… and woke up at 11:00.

— Why won't you accept me as your son-in-law? I don't drink, I don't gamble, and I've never cheated.
— Young man, I just don't want to spend the rest of my life being compared to you.

— Lisa, if the garden had a bad harvest this year, what could be the reason?
— Well, the weather was against us...
— What else?
— Well... I forgot to plant anything!

An elderly couple is getting ready for bed.
She: "You used to gently squeeze my hand before sleep..."
He groans, reaches over, and squeezes her hand.
She: "And you used to kiss me on the forehead before sleep..."
He groans, heaves himself up, and kisses her.
She: "And you used to nibble my ear..."
He grunts, gets out of bed, and reaches for his slippers.
She: "Where are you going?"
He: "To get my teeth."

— My grandfather was a real hero. He built dams, dug canals, broke new land. A shame he never made it to the big northern project...
— Did he pass away?
— No, his sentence was up.

A beginner hunter bursts through the door after his first hunt and yells in a panic:
— Quick, bring me the endangered species book!
— What happened?!
— I'll explain later, just bring it!
His wife brings the book. He frantically flips through every page to the very end, then sinks back onto the couch with a blissful sigh:
— Phew... Thank God... The guys lied — there's no game warden in the protected species list!

Three muggers cornered a drunk guy outside a bar:
— Hand over your wallet!
— No problem! — he said, reaching into his pocket.
He pulled out a gun.
— Everyone on the ground!
They dropped.
— Now swim after me!
The muggers started crawling on their bellies, doing the breaststroke.
One finally snapped:
— Are you insane? Who swims on asphalt?!
— Don't like it? Shut your mouth — or you'll be diving!

An old woman and a cleaning girl with heavy mop buckets get into the elevator.
— I'm only going to the second floor, but these are too heavy to carry up the stairs.
— You should find yourself a decent man instead of doing this kind of work.
— Did you find one?
— He died. Turned out to be weak.
I coughed to keep from bursting out laughing.
The old lady:
— Don't take this one either.

A man caught a magic fish. It said:
— Release me and I'll grant you one wish. But fair warning: whatever you receive, your wife gets ten times more.
The man scratched his head and said:
— I want to be rich!
— Done. You're a millionaire, your wife's a billionaire.
— Alright then... Now scare me half to death!

One evening a grandson asks his grandma:
"Grandma, were you pretty when you were young?"
Grandma scoffs: "'WERE'?! Boys from three villages used to chase after me!"
Grandson, puzzled: "So why did they stop?"
Grandma sighs heavily: "I retired, sweetheart… My knees are shot — I just can't keep up with them anymore!"

— Mom, I'm in love!
— What's her name? Can she cook? Who are her parents? What does she study? Is she pretty? Have you kissed yet? Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
— Dad, I'm in love.
— A girl?
— A girl.
— Cool.

Bank manager to a client:
— How many times do I have to say it: our bank, our money, our terms. We're the ones in charge here.
The client thinks for a moment:
— Got it. Then I'd like to open a savings account. I can't wait to hear what terms you'll be offering me now. After all, the money is mine.

— Hello, sweetheart, how are you?
— Mom, I can barely hear you... the kids are screaming, my head is splitting.
— I'm asking how things are going!
— How are things... I can't keep up with anything: the house is a disaster, no food, the kids are running wild, the youngest didn't sleep all night!
— Don't worry! I'll come over right now: I'll clean, do the laundry, cook something nice for the kids and your husband, feed everyone, and you get some rest!
— Which husband are you going to feed?
— Well, your Mark.
— My husband's name is actually Tom, and he went out for bread a year ago!
— Oh... I think I dialed the wrong number...
— Mom, I still don't get it — so you're not coming?

Husband came home from work furious: kicked the cat, slammed the parrot cage, yelled at his son about his grades, told his daughter to change her outfit, hinted to his mother-in-law that her visit was overdue to end, barked at his wife «Feed me!» — then went to bed, anger fully vented. By morning everyone had forgiven him. Everyone except the cat — who left a little surprise in his slipper.

— Dad, what are alcoholics?
— Well, son, you see those two trees over there?
— Yeah.
— An alcoholic sees four of them.
— Dad… there's only one tree.

— Doctor, my furniture talks.
— Interesting. How does that work exactly?
— I'm in bed with my wife, and the wardrobe goes: "I think yours has fallen asleep." Wife: "Yes, he's asleep." Wardrobe: "Right, I'm off then!" And I said: "Where do you think you're going? I haven't finished paying off your loan yet!"

Mid-argument, the husband yells at his wife:
— Where on earth did you get all that brains from?!
Mother-in-law from behind her door:
— Want me to come out and show you?

A very drunk guy walks up to a woman on the street:
— You've always dreamed of a prince on a white horse, right?
— Yes!
— Well, here I am!
— Cool... Did he fall off the horse on the way here?

A student says to his professor:
— I really don't think I deserved this grade.
The professor paused and replied:
— Neither do I. But unfortunately, there's nothing lower to give.

My daughter isn't the brightest. The other day she was walking out of a store toward our car when someone stole it right in front of her. I asked: — Did you at least get a good look at the thief? She said: — No... but I did write down the license plate number.

A man walks into a store and asks the clerk:
— Do you have boxing gloves?
— No.
— A swim cap?
— No.
— Ice skates?
— Sir, this is a liquor store!
— In that case, give me a bottle of vodka...
The clerk goes to fetch it. The man thinks to himself:
— Well, God is my witness — I genuinely tried to get into sports!

Three-year-old Max gave his dad a riddle:
— What's in my hand that starts with the letter W?
Dad racked his brain, went through everything he could think of — and finally gave up.
Max proudly opened his little palm:
— A wheel from my toy car!

A guy walks into a job interview. The manager flips through the resume and says:
"Not bad. But we're a serious company. What's your greatest strength?"
"Absolute honesty."
"Admirable. And your greatest weakness?"
"Your office is a depressing dump, and your tie looks like a horse chewed on it."
"Get out!"
"See? Honesty works. Now call the person who will actually hire me."

A husband and wife are watching a boxing match.
— I waited all week for this fight, and the guy went down in two minutes! — the husband fumes.
— You know, — sighs the wife, — I'm very familiar with that feeling too.

An elderly woman goes to see her doctor.
— Doctor, everything aches — my joints, my shoulder, I can barely sleep. What's my diagnosis?
The doctor examines her and says:
— You have OA.
— Is that serious?
— Old Age.

Husband to wife:
"Did you know scientists found that men say about 4,000 words a day, while women say over 8,000?"
Wife shouts from the kitchen:
"That's because we have to repeat everything twice for you!"
Husband:
"What?"

We were once buying a car from a couple. The husband found out I'm a nail technician and asked: 'Is it true you can't wash dishes with gel nails?' Without thinking, I said: 'Why not? Of course you can.' You should have seen the look his wife gave me...

— I have no idea how they hacked my laptop — I had a super complicated password!
— What was it?
— The year Saint Dominic was canonized by Pope Gregory IX.
— Okay... and what year is that exactly?
— Twelve thirty-four...

At the eye doctor. The doctor points to a letter.
— Which letter is this?
— "Me."
— Sir, there is no letter "me"! It's "em"! Do you understand? Em!
— What's "em"?!
— You look like an educated man — glasses, hat, briefcase! What do you mean "ne"?! It's "en"! Next letter — what is it?
[silence]
— Can't you see it?
— I can see it...
— Then why the silence?! Which letter is this?!
— "Ep"?

The teacher asks the class what is the most valuable thing in their family.
— We have Dad's car, says Masha. He takes such good care of it!
— We have Mom's necklace, says Petya. She never takes it off!
Little Tommy raises his hand:
— We have... monthly cycles.
— Excuse me? Do you even know what that means?
— Not really... But when my sister said hers hadn't come — Mom fainted, Dad had a stroke, and the neighbor shot himself.

My daughter comes home from school and says:
— Today in English class we learned 'hello' and 'mayonnaise'.
— Okay, 'hello' makes sense — but what does mayonnaise have to do with it?
— That's how we learned to say 'Hello, my name is...'

A father gathered his three sons:
— Tell me honestly: which one of you pushed the outhouse into the river this morning?
Silence.
— Don't be scared! Remember young George Washington: he chopped down his father's cherry tree, admitted it when asked, and wasn't punished.
The middle son steps forward:
— It was me, Dad...
The father immediately grabs his belt. The son bursts into tears:
— But Dad, you just told us about Washington and the cherry tree!
— When Washington chopped the cherry tree, his father wasn't sitting in it!

A husband suspected his wife was going deaf and decided to test her scientifically. While she was cooking in the kitchen, he stood in the hallway and called out:
— Honey, what's for dinner?
Silence. He moved closer, right to the kitchen doorway:
— Honey, what's for dinner?
Nothing. He walked up to her and shouted in her ear:
— Honey, what's for dinner?!
She spun around and snapped:
— Are you kidding me?! I've already told you THREE times: CHICKEN!

Son (1 year 4 months old):
— Mom, why don't you have hair clips?
— Because my hair is short.
— Who has long hair?
— Girls do.
The child stares at her in genuine horror:
— Mom... so what exactly are you?

A man bought a parrot, but the bird did nothing but swear all day. He tried everything — nothing worked. Finally he'd had enough and shoved the parrot into the freezer. A minute passed, then another... Suddenly the parrot knocked from inside:
— Excuse me, sir, I've seen the light. Not another bad word, I promise!
The man opened the freezer, the parrot stepped out shivering and quietly asked:
— Just one question though... what exactly did that chicken in the next compartment do?!

People never cease to amaze me! Champagne, vodka, beer with grilled meat, then cognac, whisky, coffee with cake, and half a pack of cigarettes a day — all perfectly fine. But the water in the kettle MUST be filtered — because your health comes first!

A 50-year-old man set off to visit his mistress. He walked into the building and saw a sign: "Elevator out of order." No problem, he thought — the wings of love will carry me to the 15th floor!

By the 3rd floor he was sprinting.
By the 6th he was walking.
By the 8th he was popping heart pills.
By the 12th he collapsed on the stairs, wiped his forehead, and muttered:

"Please, God, let her not be home..."

— Want a tangerine?
— No.
— What if I peel it for you?
— Then yes!
May you always have someone in your life who will peel your tangerine for you.

Mother-in-law came to visit and locked herself in the kitchen with her daughter. The son-in-law sat alone watching TV. Suddenly his little son ran up:
— Dad, where did I come from?
— A stork brought you.
— And you?
— The stork brought me too.
— And Mom?
— Mom too.
— And Grandma?
— Grandma... the devil brought her.

I have two university degrees, but yesterday I couldn't help my son with a 4th-grade math problem. I was upset at first... Then I remembered — they skipped us straight from 3rd to 5th grade back in the day. Suddenly felt a whole lot better.

Got a message: 'Helo beutiful. I am ur dreem!' Wanted to write back: 'Learn English, dummy!' — but held myself back. I reply: 'Helo! If u hav a car, an apartmnt and stedy job — ur totaly my dreem!' You won't believe it, he responds: 'Wtf, r u not even English?!'

A foreman gave two painters two buckets of paint to paint the walls. At lunch, the guys decided to sell one bucket and drink the money away. To cover their tracks, they smeared paint all over a nearby horse's face. That evening the foreman shows up — both painters are wasted and the job is half done.
— Why didn't you finish?
— We ran out of paint.
— I gave you more than enough, even extra for the fence!
— The horse drank it. Look at him — his whole face is covered in paint.
— That beast still isn't dead?! Last week it ate an entire pallet of bricks!

A doctor had a huge fight with his wife at breakfast and blurted out: "You know what — you're not even that great in bed!" Then he stormed off to work. By mid-morning, guilt got the better of him and he called home.
— Why did it take you so long to pick up?
— I was in bed, she replied.
— In bed?! At this hour? What were you doing there?
— Getting a second opinion.

The neighbor asked Sasha to install a program on her laptop. He did everything and set his kitten's photo as the wallpaper. While he wasn't looking, a friend quietly swapped the kitten for a photo of... a very different nature. Sasha didn't notice and handed the laptop back.
An hour later she calls:
— Sasha, whose is THAT on your screen?
— Mine! Come over — I'll let you pet it!

— Natasha, I'm no longer your driving instructor. You're overreacting — I only failed to yield to one pedestrian at a crossing!
— IT WAS AN UNDERGROUND CROSSING, NATASHA!

An old man at his country house wakes up in the middle of the night — someone is stealing potatoes from his garden. He calls the police:
— There are thieves robbing my garden!
— No cars available, we'll come when we can.
Five minutes later he calls back:
— Don't bother coming, I already shot them all.
Three minutes later — sirens, flashing lights, the whole yard packed with police. The thieves are arrested.
— You said you shot them all?
— Well, you said you had no cars.

Before the operation, the patient lays out the payment plan to the surgeon:
— Here's the deal: nurses get $10 each, you get $200, and the anesthesiologist gets $500.
— Hold on — $500 for the anesthesiologist? Just for putting you to sleep?!
— Putting me to sleep costs $10. The rest is for waking me up.

The Japanese invented a clock that jumps one minute forward every time it hears swearing. Time to test it. They hung it in a Japanese bar — after 24 hours it was 2 minutes fast. In an English bar — 5 minutes fast. Then they hung it in a Russian bar. They came back the next day — the clock was gone.
They went to the bartender:
— We hung a clock here yesterday. Where is it?
The bartender, baffled:
— Hold on... that was a CLOCK?! We thought someone had put up a fan in the middle of winter!

When my husband was a college student, he came home for the holidays. As he was leaving, his mom handed him some cash: "Sweetheart, your eyesight is getting worse — buy some blueberry eye supplements and drink the whole course." — "Sure." — "Promise me you'll drink it!" — "I promise, I'll drink it." His dad smiled a mysterious smile.

A police officer walks up to a parked car. Inside, a young guy is reading a magazine and a girl is knitting socks. He taps on the window:
— What are you two doing here?
— Can't you see? I'm reading.
— And her?
— She's knitting socks.
— How old are you?
— Nineteen.
— And her?
The guy glances at his watch:
— In ten minutes — eighteen.

A wife snuggles up to her husband in bed:
— Honey, do you want anything?
— I do.
— Really? What?
— A drink.
She gets up, pours him a glass — thinking he'll get the hint. A minute later:
— And now? Want anything?
— I do... another drink.
She pours again. Irritated:
— Don't you want ANYTHING else?!
— A drink.
She jumps out of bed, runs to the balcony and shouts to the street:
— Is there a real man in this neighborhood?!
A voice from below:
— Hey, you got anything to drink?

Two friends run into each other.
— You've lost so much weight! How?
— My husband is cheating on me. I'm a nervous wreck, can't sleep...
— Just leave him!
— Not yet. I still have three more kilos to lose.
— What pairs best with Mexican cuisine? — Tequila. — German? — Beer. — Italian? — Wine. — And Russian? — Russian food isn't washed down with a drink — the drink is washed down with Russian food!
Many men are haunted by the same question: "Should you confess an affair to your wife?" Tonight, two top experts will answer live — the city traumatologist and the pathologist.

Three weeks after the wedding. A young wife calls her mom in tears.
— Mom, I don't know what to do! Something terrible happened at home!
— Calm down, sweetheart. Every family goes through their first fights — it's completely normal.
— Oh, I know about fights. But what do I do with the body?

Three school friends meet up ten years later. They're sitting in a café, catching up over drinks.

The first one says:
— I married a professor.
— How old is he?
— Eighty.
— But what about your love life?
— He has young female assistants for that.

Silence. The second:
— I married a general.
— How old is he?
— Almost eighty.
— And your love life?
— He has young adjutants.

They ask the third:
— What about you?
— Same profession — just self-employed.

A man on a plane suddenly starts screaming at the top of his lungs. The flight attendant rushes over:
— What happened?
— I was trying to smuggle a squirrel in my underwear...
— So?
— First she mistook my backside for a tree hollow, then my nuts for actual nuts... And the third time she started stuffing the nuts into the hollow!

A guy messages me: 'Don't let my age fool you — I'm over 50 but in bed I'm a total stallion!' I reply: 'What does that mean exactly? You neigh, kick, wheeze and leave a mess?' He never messaged again. Must have taken it personally...

The executioner spent all night sharpening his axe for his milestone 1,000th execution — honed to a razor's edge. In the morning the condemned man lays his head on the block, the axe swings...
— Is that it? Already? — asks the condemned.
— Yes, — says the executioner.
— But I didn't feel a thing.
— Then nod.

A funeral procession pulls up to the cemetery. Last in line — a black truck towing a trailer, a boat on the trailer, a coffin in the boat. A passerby remarks:
— The deceased must have been a devoted fisherman...
Someone from the procession:
— Why "must have been"? We're burying the wife first — then straight to the lake!
A doctor profits when you're sick. A lawyer is pleased when you're in trouble. A mechanic is happy when your car breaks down. Only a thief sincerely wishes you wealth and prosperity!

Winnie the Pooh is walking through the forest and spots Eeyore looking glum.
— What's wrong, Eeyore?
— Oh, Pooh, I feel just terrible!
— Come on, your tail is there, ears are fine — what's there to be sad about?
— I seem to have lost my egg somewhere...
Pooh scratched his head thoughtfully and said:
— That explains where Owl got her new earrings!

A tiny nurse is dragging a huge soldier off the battlefield, barely keeping up.
— Leave me, he says. Save yourself.
— I won't.
— Come on, drop me — it's too heavy for you!
— I'll manage.
— I'm begging you, let me go. — No.
— Then at least get off the horse.

Three fathers are waiting at the maternity ward. The doctor approaches the first:
— Congratulations, you have twins!
— What a coincidence, — the man grins — I own a company called Two Eagles!
The doctor goes to the second:
— You have triplets!
— Unbelievable! I run a company called Three Hazelnuts!
The third father overhears, turns ghostly pale, and sinks into his chair. The nurse rushes over:
— Are you alright?
— I... I own a company called Seven Dwarfs...

Husband to wife:
— Look at you! You took the big piece and left me the small one!
— And what would YOU have done in my place?
— I would have taken the small piece, of course...
— Well then! That's exactly what I gave you!

A boy walks into a barbershop. The barber whispers to a customer:
"Watch this kid — total dummy. Let me prove it."
He holds out a dollar in one hand and a five in the other. The boy takes the dollar and walks off.
"See? What did I tell you!" the barber crows.
Later, the customer spots the boy leaving an ice cream shop and asks:
"Hey, why do you always take the smaller bill?"
"Because the moment I take the bigger one, the game is over."

A woman comes to the village registry office to register her newborn. The clerk asks:
— Who's the father?
— Vaska from Chernovka.
— How interesting! This week, Zinka from Sosnovka, Manka from Vorobyovka, and Katerina Matveevna from the farm — they all named the same man: Vaska from Chernovka! How does he manage?!
— Well, he has a bicycle!

A man is riding home across the steppe in great spirits, singing at the top of his lungs:
— Clear skies, not a cloud in sight! My horse is fast — I'll be home soon. Aah! There's my home in the distance, and my wife is standing in the doorway...
— Dammit, she ruined the whole song!

I accidentally grabbed my wife's phone and — out of curiosity — opened her contacts. I see: "My Love." I call. A sleepy male voice answers.
— Who is this?
— Reginald, her beloved. The hairdresser. You people are driving me absolutely crazy!

Went into an organic shop and saw a woman buying "snowdrop honey." I asked: did bees collect it, or was it elves? She and the shopkeeper looked at me like I'd spat directly on their third chakra. I get it — in the name of wellness, people will believe anything. But snowdrop honey! I can just picture it: frozen little bees, swearing their tiny heads off, buzzing through snowdrifts desperately searching for snowdrops.

— Dad, what if nobody ever wants to marry me?
— Don't worry. Get a love potion from your mom, slip it into someone's drink — and you're all set.
— Wait... does she actually have one?!
— She must. No matter how long I look at her, I can't find any other reason why I married her.

One farmer dropped by to visit his neighbor.
— Hey, why is your rooster wearing pants?
— My wife accidentally spilled boiling water on him — his backside lost all its feathers. We stitched him a little pair of trousers so he wouldn't freeze.
— Hasn't it grown back by now?
— Oh, the feathers grew back alright. But he's hilarious to watch now: he holds the hen with one foot and pulls his pants down with the other!

— This is the auto repair shop calling. Your wife came in to get her car fixed, and we're not sure who will be covering the bill.
— No worries, just send it to me.
— Oh, the car is the least of our concerns. What we really want to know is: who's going to pay for the repairs to our workshop?

A guy walks into a car dealership. The salesman takes him for a test drive and says:
— See that tree over there? Close your eyes.
The guy closes his eyes, the salesman quietly drives around the tree, then says:
— Open up! We just drove straight through that tree! So, you buying it?
— I'll take it!
Next day, the guy takes his friends for a ride:
— See that tree? Close your eyes!
He floors it — BANG. Straight into the tree. Car totalled. He yells:
— Which one of you idiots didn't close their eyes?!

A tipsy man bursts into the maternity ward.
— Let me in! I want to see my son!
The staff tries to calm him:
— Sir, once she's discharged you can see him all you want at home.
The man, through tears:
— That's the problem — her husband won't let me in the house.

A man pokes his head into a bus, points his finger at the driver and says:
— Bang, bang, bang...
Driver:
— Done shooting everyone? Alright, hop on!
Man (still pointing):
— Bang... Do you go along Main Street?

Baba Yaga catches a handsome young man:
"Guess my riddle — and I'm all yours. Wrong answer — I eat you! Green, hops through the swamp, starts with 'F' and ends with 'ROG'."
"A grasshopper!"
"Oh, you cheeky rascal — correct!"

After class, the teacher calls the boy over:
— Tomorrow, don't come to school without your parents!
The boy thinks for a moment and asks:
— What about the day after tomorrow?

Two sheep are chatting in the field.
— You know, I'm more and more convinced that humans only keep us around to shear our wool.
— Oh please, don't make me laugh with your ridiculous conspiracy theories!
A real man sets his alarm for 6 AM. The alarm goes off. He opens one eye, looks at his phone... and sets it for 7. Because he's a grown adult and makes his own decisions.

One night, a man died during a poker game. His friends had to figure out how to break the news to his wife. They sent Victor — the most tactful of the bunch. He knocked on her door.
— Hello, Susan!
— Hi, Victor!
— Susan, your husband came by last night to play poker with us. We played all night, and I have to say his luck was terrible — he lost a huge amount of money.
— I hope he drops dead!!
— He already did...

— Katie, why do you look so sad today?
— Tom, I went to a haunted house. In this dark cave, a coffin lid slowly creaks open, a half-decomposed corpse rises up, looks at me — then lets out a strangled scream, dives back in, and slams the lid shut. Am I really that terrifying?
I called grandma to ask how many eggs I need for my pastries. She sighed deeply: "Two, sweetheart. You just need two eggs — and their owner will buy you all the pastries you want."

Standing in line at the pharmacy. Dead silence. The guy in front of me steps up to the counter.
— What can I get you?
— A pregnancy test.
— Which kind?
— Negative, if that's an option.
The entire queue collapsed laughing.

— Yesterday my husband finally told me everything he really thinks about me.
— Did you kill him?
— No. I just felt so sorry for him. Poor guy — look who he has to live with...

Fishermen held a contest: who can tell the biggest whopper?
First: "I once caught a pike that weighed 45 pounds."
Everyone: "Sure, could happen."
Second: "I reeled in a catfish at 125 pounds!"
Everyone: "Okay, possible."
Third: "I had a day so bad I didn't get a single bite — and I was so disappointed I didn't crack open one beer the whole trip. Brought it all back home."
Everyone: "NOW you're lying!"

— Madam, if you don't mind, how old are you?
— Let me calculate... When I got married, I was 20 and my husband was 40 — I was exactly half his age. Now he's 70, so I must be 35!

— How many languages do you speak?
— Three: French, English, and Chinese.
— Say something in English.
— Guten Tag.
— That's German!
— Well, make it four then.

The boss noticed that his employee — a composed, respectable man — had suddenly started wearing an earring. He couldn't hold back and finally asked:
— Even the old guard is catching up with fashion trends?
— Oh, the earring? Don't worry about it. Sometimes you've got to do something unexpected.
— And how long has this been going on?
— Ever since my wife found this earring in our bed.

— For your husband to recover faster, he needs to drink more and go out more.
— Doctor, then I honestly have no idea how he managed to get sick in the first place!

— I was NOT drunk last night!
— Right. So who was shouting at the waiter: "Bring me the door — I want to leave!"?

— Honey, I've been thinking...
— Wow, you actually think?
— Sometimes, yeah...
— And what were you thinking about?
— That we should go to the beach!
— Great! When are we leaving?
— That's the problem...
— What problem?
— We have no money.
— But you just thought about the beach!
— So what? I also think about a million dollars — but I'm not going anywhere with that either!

An 85-year-old man went to the doctor to give a sperm sample. The doctor handed him a small jar:
"Bring it back tomorrow morning."
Next morning the old man returns with the jar empty:
"I tried with one hand, then the other. My wife tried with her hands, then with her mouth — with her dentures in and without. Then we called the neighbor..."
"You even brought in the neighbor?!"
"Yes. But we still couldn't get that jar open."

— Hey, why are both your ears bandaged?
— I was ironing a shirt, the phone rang — so I held the iron up to my ear.
— I see. And the second ear?
— Well, I had to call the ambulance back.

A woman tells her friend:
— Yesterday my husband told me the whole truth about what I'm really like.
— And you smacked him for it, right?
— No. I just felt sorry for him. I mean, who does he have to live with?!

— Grandson, in our village there was no internet, no social media, nothing...
— But Grandpa, how did you ever meet girls?
— We had haystacks, boy. Plenty of them. And in a haystack, you make all the connections you need.

The Sultan summoned his eunuch:
— Bring me my first wife.
The eunuch brought her. Then the second, the third, the fourth... the tenth. The palace corridors were endlessly long — the poor eunuch was completely worn out. When the Sultan sent him for the eleventh, the eunuch finally dared to ask:
— Oh great lord, you've just been with ten wives and look perfectly fresh, while I can barely stand. How do you do it?
The Sultan replied:
— It's not your passion that tires you — it's the pointless running back and forth through the corridors.

A divorce hearing is underway. Judge:
— Please state the reasons that led you to file for divorce.
Wife:
— I recently discovered, quite by accident, that my husband is the owner of the apartment we've been renting together for fifteen years.
Judge:
— Holy sh*t... That's brilliant.

— Dad, I want to get married!
— Who's the lucky girl, son?
— Kate from our street.
— Oh, better not, son... Alright, I have to confess — I had a fling back in the day. She's your sister.
— Then I'll marry Lena, the girl next door.
— She's your sister too, son.
— Then what about Masha from across the yard?
— Also your sister...
At that point Mom couldn't hold back and shouted from the kitchen:
— Go ahead and marry whoever you want, son — he's not your father anyway!

A traffic officer pulls over a couple.
"Speed limit's 50 — you were going faster."
"Officer, I was doing exactly 50!" says the husband.
"Honey, your speedometer showed 70," pipes up the wife.
The husband shoots her a glare. The officer keeps going:
"And your rear light is broken."
"I had no idea..."
"I told you two weeks ago!" the wife chimes in.
The husband's glare darkens.
"Seatbelts weren't fastened either."
"I just took mine off."
"You never wear your seatbelt!" the wife adds.
The husband snaps: "Will you SHUT UP!"
The officer raises an eyebrow: "Does he always talk to you like that?"
The wife sighs: "No... only when he's been drinking."

— Tommy, give me your report card right now! I'm giving you an F — your dad is going to deal with you!
— My father is completely indifferent to your negative assessment.
— Speak normally, please!
— He couldn't care less, Ms. Johnson.

A woman placed a personal ad: "Seeking a man — no hitting, no cheating, and he must satisfy me."

Next day, someone rings the doorbell. She opens the door — a man with no arms and no legs is standing there. She's stunned:

— Are you here about the ad?
— Yes! I can't hit you — no arms. I won't chase other women — no legs. But you're looking for someone who will satisfy you, right?
— And…?
— Well, I somehow managed to ring your doorbell!

A guy shows up to work on time for the very first time in his life. His boss is shocked:
— What happened?
— I bought a parrot!
— What's a parrot gonna do? You can't even hear the loudest alarm clock.
— I put the alarm clock in the parrot's cage!
— And?
— In the morning the parrot flies out, lands on my pillow, and screams in my ear: "Mike, turn off that damn alarm clock!"

A man went to confession.
— I suppose you eat meat during the fast, my son?
— No, Father, I'm innocent there.
— You drink too much, then?
— Not guilty of that either, Father.
— At least you chase after married women?
— Yes, Father, that one I'm guilty of...
The priest, relieved:
— Thank God! I was starting to think you were a complete idiot.

My little brother (4 years old) was jumping on the bed. To stop him I said: "Keep jumping and your belly will get as round as Dad's!" It worked. Then on a walk he spotted a pregnant woman and yelled: "Ha! You've been jumping too, haven't you?!" You should have seen her face...

A five-year-old boy read a story about a king and announced to his mom:
— I want five wives too! One will cook, one will sing, one will bathe me...
— And the fifth will put you to sleep, added his mom.
— No, Mom, I'll always sleep with YOU!
Tears welled up in his mother's eyes.
— God bless you, my son! But who will sleep with the five wives?
— Dad can sleep with them!
Tears welled up in his dad's eyes too.
— God bless you, son!

Train compartment, London. The conductor walks in and politely says to a lady passenger:
— Ma'am, could you close the window, please?
— Oh, sir, my cheek is ever so small!
— Then pass the window to someone with a bigger cheek — let them close it!

A man comes to confession:
— Father, I have sinned. I cheated someone out of ten thousand dollars. How can I be forgiven?
— My son, you must return that money.
— But I don't know where he lives, and I can't even remember what he looks like.
— Then donate it to the church, and God will forgive you.
The man pulls out a wad of cash, counts out five thousand, and hands it to the priest.
— Where's the other five thousand? the priest asks.
— I already owe that half directly to God!

Can't afford a urine test? Check yourself for free — just pee under a tree!
— Ants show up: high blood sugar.
— Flies swarm: inflammation.
— Dries fast: too much salt.
— Smells like meat: high cholesterol.
— You forgot to pull down your pants: Alzheimer's.
— You can't smell anything: COVID!

A soldier husband catches his wife with her lover. He draws his gun:
— Both of you — outside.
They go out. The husband tells the lover:
— Let's settle this once and for all. I'll fire twice — we both go down. Whoever my wife runs to first, she's his.
Two shots ring out. The wife peeks out the window and yells:
— Johnny, you can come out now! These two idiots shot each other!

A man walks through town with a goose tucked under his arm. A police officer stops him:
— Hey! What is this, a barnyard? Why are you carrying a goose around?
— So what? You've got pigeons roaming the square freely!
— That's different — pigeons are birds of peace!
— May I drop dead if my goose has anything but peace on his mind!

A friend complains:
"My husband is driving me crazy — it's always 'Mom said this, Mom did that!'"
I tell her:
"Put on black lace lingerie, black stockings, heels — when he sees you like that, he'll forget his mom exists!"
So she does it. Her husband comes home, opens the door, stares at her and gasps:
"Oh God! Why are you dressed all in black?! Did something happen to Mom?!"

— Is that your car?
— Sort of.
— What do you mean?
— Well: it's registered to my wife, my son drives it, my daughter borrows it for weekend trips — but the moment it needs repairs, it's suddenly mine.

A husband and wife walk into a spa. The receptionist looks them over and says:
— I'm not letting you share a room!
The husband is outraged:
— Why not?! She's my wife!
The receptionist, calmly:
— Doesn't matter to me. It's the principle. She's been here four times today already — always as someone's wife.

A village. Evening. The old man says to his wife:
— Come on, old girl, let's remember our youth!
— How exactly?
— Like a bull and a cow! The cow stands in one corner, the bull in the other. The cow moos, the bull charges — and leaps!
— All right, let's try...

They take their positions. Darkness. Silence.
Wife:
— Moo!..
Stomping... heavy breathing... then suddenly — CRASH! BANG! CLATTER! A scream. Silence...
Wife:
— Moo?.. Moo-oo-oo???
A muffled voice from below:
— Stop mooing already! Come close the cellar hatch — I fell in!

Mother-in-law says to her son-in-law:
— Son, when I die — don't bury me, just cremate me. Scatter my ashes right here in the yard.
Son-in-law:
— No thanks, Mom. One little breeze and you're back in the house again...

My grandmother is old and full of complaints — blood pressure, heart, legs, hearing, vision, can barely breathe. She begs us to bring her food. We live 30 kilometers away and only visit on weekends: mop floors, cook, keep her company. One day my husband got a weekday off and we showed up unannounced at noon. Found her strolling outside, perfectly fine. The moment she spotted us, she turned and bolted. She made it up four flights of stairs faster than me — not even winded. The cover was nearly blown.

A man is stuck in traffic when someone knocks on his window. He rolls it down.
— What's going on?
— You see, terrorists have kidnapped the Finance Minister and are demanding ten million dollars. If they don't get it, they'll douse him in gasoline and set him on fire. We're going car to car collecting whatever people can contribute.
— Well… I could probably spare about five liters.

A guy on a moped crashes into a large woman on the sidewalk.
— Couldn't you go around me?!
— I was afraid I'd run out of gas.

My husband and I went into an auto parts store for some light bulbs. A woman rushes in needing a fuel pump. She explains to the guys behind the counter: "I need the one where you don't have to suck — you just squeeze with your hands and it flows by itself!" The staff went completely silent and took a very long time to recover.

A mother-in-law and her daughter-in-law are arguing in the kitchen.
— Mother-in-law (angrily): At your age I already knew how to do everything: cook, do laundry, and obey my husband!
— Daughter-in-law (calmly): And at your age, I'm planning to know how to relax and stay out of other people's lives…
— Mother-in-law (outraged): Is that a hint?!
— Daughter-in-law (smiling): Not at all… I'm just making plans for the future.

An elderly woman decided to write her will. She called a lawyer and said:
— I want to leave everything I own to my grandchildren.
The lawyer raised an eyebrow:
— And how many grandchildren do you have?
— None yet. But you have to motivate your kids somehow!

Get this! They brought a guy to the cemetery to bury him. Suddenly he sits up in the coffin: 'Hold on, hold on — I'm alive!' What happened next! Everyone laughing, cheering, someone blew up balloons, someone popped party crackers, his wife sobbing with joy... Long story short, they barely managed to get him in the ground.

A dinner party. The general stands up:
— Well, to health!
Everyone drinks. Glasses are refilled. The general stands again:
— To health!
They drink. Glasses are filled once more.
— General, could we perhaps toast to luck for a change?
The general rises:
— Funny you mention luck. Just recently I shared a train compartment with a stunning young lady. What luck! But my health wasn't up to it... So — to health!

Two friends chatting.
— Jenny, weren't you going to marry Dave? When's the wedding?
— I changed my mind. He wants me to take his surname.
— Fair enough — "Jenny Ramsbottom" isn't ideal... then again, "Jenny Shufflebottom" is no prize either!

— Maggie, why on earth did you buy so many condoms? You haven't had a boyfriend in ages!
— Oh, Carol! My nosy neighbor was standing right behind me in the pharmacy queue. For the look on her face — every penny was worth it!

— Why did you leave your last job?
— Due to exhaustion.
— Whose exhaustion?
— I have no idea. They just said they were very exhausted by me.

From the doctors' group chat. The day before yesterday, a patient born in 1927 came to my appointment and complained:
— Can you believe it?! I'm not even 100 yet and my knees already hurt. I might have to give up my garden!
Meanwhile, I'm sitting there thinking: I'm not even 35, my entire body aches — and I don't even have a garden...

Attention, drivers! Please let people with a white cane pass — they have poor eyesight. Also let people with a selfie stick pass — those ones are completely oblivious to everything around them. But stay far away from people with a striped baton — those ones see absolutely everything!

I'm studying to be an electrician. Judging by me and my classmates, after graduation half of us will electrocute ourselves and the other half will knock out power to half the city. My brother is studying medicine — those the electricity doesn't kill, he and his classmates will finish off.

A husband and wife are watching a movie. Suddenly the husband asks:
— Honey, what would you do if I won 10 million dollars in the lottery?
— I'd take my half and divorce you on the spot! — she replies without hesitation.
The husband pulls a lottery ticket from his pocket:
— Perfect. I won 20 dollars yesterday. Here's your ten — pack your bags and get out!

A young woman walks into a gym and tells the trainer:
— I want a body by summer that makes every man on the beach crane his neck!
The trainer looks her up and down and replies:
— I have the perfect exercise for you.
— Squats? Planks?
— No. Every time you feel like eating, turn your head left, then right.
— How long should I do that?
— Until the food disappears from the table.

Husband comes home from work and calls out:
— Where's my little sweetie?
Wife pokes her head out:
— I'm right here!
Husband mutters under his breath:
— You're a grumpy rabbit. I was calling our daughter.

A new young aide started in our ward — sweet, clueless, an easy target for pranks. She's spoon-feeding a patient, he's had enough, and I rush over:
— He doesn't want any more — you finish it!
— What? I don't want it either!
— That's the rule here! If you won't finish it, go ask the head nurse for permission to leave it!
And she actually went! I immediately regretted it, sitting there waiting for the telling-off. She comes back wearing the most baffled expression:
— I told her exactly what you said.
— And?
— She said: "Leave it — I'll finish it myself!"

Taxi dispatch: "Car 23, can you pick someone up? He's desperate to catch his flight — takes off at 5 PM."
"Sure, I've got room."
"He's asking: will you make it in time?"
"I guarantee he won't miss that flight."
"How can you possibly guarantee that in this traffic?!"
"Easy — I'm driving the pilot."

A husband and wife are getting ready for bed.
— So, honey... no headache tonight?
— No headache... but something's aching in my side.
— You know what, this whole month the only thing that didn't hurt on you was your eyebrows!

— Teacher, why do I even need algebra? When will I ever use it in real life?
— You'll think of me when you're thirty-five, sitting at the kitchen table doing homework with your own kid.

On a plane: "A woman is going into labor! Is there a doctor on board?" A man raises his hand:
— Miss, let me try!
— Are you a doctor?
— No, I'm an avid ice fisherman. But trust my experience — I can pull anything out of any hole!

A husband is getting changed. His wife notices scratches on his back:
— Honey, who on earth scratched up your back like that?
He shifts uncomfortably:
— You won't believe it — I was walking down the street and a cat fell right on my back from a balcony!
— Really?
— Yeah... you believe me, right?
— Of course I do. It's even written there in lipstick: "Your pussy."

A husband gets a text. His wife grabs the phone:
— Why is the contact saved as "Plumber" texting you "I feel lost without you"?
— Oh, that's just Bob — he must miss me, we play chess together all the time...
— Well, judging by the second message, you've played your last game.

My husband texted: "What coffee should I get?" I replied: "I want one that's strong yet smooth, bold yet tender — one that'll turn everything inside me upside down, open up a world of new sensations and temptations, make my head spin and my heart flutter!" After a long wait, his reply finally came: "Got it. I'm buying vodka!"

A bunch of guys are hanging out, everyone's having a blast — except one who looks miserable.
"Hey, what's wrong with you?"
"They found gonorrhea in my wife..."
Dead silence. Everyone exchanges glances.
"Relax, I'm joking! Why did you all go so pale?"
One guy slowly exhales:
"Phew... We thought you were about to go home..."

— Honey, when the Johnsons got a new sofa, you wanted the same — I bought it. Then they got new furniture — I went into debt, but bought it for us too. Then they went on a European cruise — I worked three jobs so we could go too. Now there's another problem. What should I do?
— Did they buy something again?!
— Yes! Johnson just got a new wife!

A guy calls his mom in a panic:
— Mom, I washed my white t-shirts with red socks and now they're all pink! What do I do?!
Mom sighs:
— Write "Glamour" on each one, tell everyone it's a limited edition collection, and sell them to your fashionista friend for triple the price.

I step outside — not a soul around. Suddenly, soldiers come charging around the corner straight at me. I bolt. Ran and ran until I hit a dead end. No choice — I dive into a manhole. There are already people sitting inside.
— Guys, they're handing out draft notices up there!
— Up there they're not handing out notices — they're rounding people up. Down here we hand them out. Sign here.

An optician is training his son:
"When a customer asks the price of the glasses, say '$200'. If their eyes don't go wide, clarify: $200 for the frames and $200 for the lenses. If they still don't flinch — explain: $200 per lens."

A woman walks into a doctor's office:
— Doctor, I'd like a general check-up. What do I need to fix?
— First, see a cosmetician — with those looks, you must be spending a fortune on makeup.
— You're right.
— And a nutritionist — the extra weight is hard to miss.
— Alright.
— And get your eyes checked!
— Why my eyes?
— Because my door says "VETERINARIAN" in big letters!

Road works knocked out the trolleybuses, so the city sent ordinary buses on the same routes with the same numbers. The catch: bus route #11 already existed and partly overlapped with trolleybus route #11. Bus #11 pulls up to the stop, passengers ask: "Is this the bus or the trolleybus?" The driver answers: "The trolleybus." And everyone gets it.

A woman visits the doctor:
— Doctor, whenever I take off my bra, my breasts rise up!
— How curious... Let's have a look then. Go ahead and take it off.
She does — and sure enough, they rise.
— So, doctor, what's your diagnosis?
— I can only say one thing so far: this disease is contagious.

I sent my husband to the store with a list:
1. Bread
2. Sausage
3. Milk
4. Toothpaste
5. Toilet paper
6. Beer
He came back — I checked the bags: one loaf of bread, two sausages, three cartons of milk, four tubes of toothpaste, five rolls of toilet paper, and six bottles of beer. Nothing to complain about, but next time beer goes first on the list.

A family sits down to lunch. The son refuses to eat his porridge. Mom scolds him — the boy bursts into tears. Dad leans over and whispers something in his ear. The son immediately wolfs down the porridge and runs outside. Mom asks in disbelief:
— What did you tell him?
— That if he doesn't eat his porridge, his willy won't grow.
Mom grabs the spoon and whacks Dad right on the forehead.
— What was that for?!
— For not eating your porridge as a kid.

Stalin comes back to life and shows up at a parliament session. Everyone freezes. He stands up and announces:
— First: shoot all the deputies and the government. Second: paint the mausoleum green.
From the back, someone timidly raises a hand:
— Why green of all colors?
Stalin nods:
— I knew there'd be no objections to the first point.

— Dad, today in class the teacher asked a question and I was the first to raise my hand!
— That's great, son! What did she ask?
— Who couldn't solve the problem.

At the zoo, a bear storms into the director's office:
— Please move me to another cage, I can't take it anymore! There's a monkey on my right and a giraffe on my left. The monkey tells jokes all day long, and the giraffe laughs all night.

The daughter finally got her driver's license and gave her mom a lift home for the first time. When they pulled up, the mother said, "Thank you." "You're welcome," said the daughter. "I wasn't talking to you — I was talking to God."

At the fish market, sad Sara stands behind her stall. A regular customer walks up:
"Sara, give me... that fish over there. Oh, and why do you look so glum today?"
"You know what would cheer me right up? If you'd stopped talking after 'give me'!"
Grandma always said: "Surprise your man in bed!" So for three days now I've been sleeping naked — but wearing a hat. Today he asked if there's any history of mental illness in my family.

A buddy told me: he went fishing with three idiots. That night, the first one slipped off into the bushes and never came back. The second followed — vanished. Then the third — same story. My buddy sat alone by the campfire, waited, started getting nervous — middle of nowhere, after all. So he went looking for them. Found all three: the first one was doubled over in pain, the second was shining a flashlight at his backside, and the third was picking away at something back there. Turns out the first guy had wiped himself with a newspaper — the one the fishing hooks had been wrapped in.

A strawberry, a walnut, and a banana were chatting at a market stall.
— Strawberry: "Everyone loves me — I'm shaped like a heart!"
— Walnut: "A heart? Big deal. I'm shaped like a brain!"
— Banana: "Guys... can we please change the subject?"

A man was driven crazy by cockroaches. He tried every spray and poison — nothing worked. The bugs just wouldn't die, and they seemed to be mutating. He complained to his neighbor.
"Before bed," said the neighbor, "walk to every corner of your place and say: 'Nothing to eat here.'"
The man shrugged and tried it. He made the rounds, said the words, and went to sleep. In the middle of the night something poked his shoulder. He opened his eyes — a massive crowd of cockroaches surrounded him, and the biggest one said:
"Hey buddy, wake up. We brought you food."

— Son, how was your day?
— We played doctor at kindergarten today.
— How did it go?
— I spent half the day sitting in the hallway outside the door.

***

Chief physician:
— Bonuses will only be paid for regular patients.
Pathologist:
— Finally, my time has come!

A husband and wife arrive at their summer cottage to find everything overgrown with weeds. The husband says:
— Well, we're really going to enjoy ourselves here!
The wife:
— Wait — so we're not weeding?

A buddy told me this. He went fishing with three pals. At night, the first guy slipped into the bushes to answer nature's call — and never came back. The second went to check — vanished too. Then the third — same thing. My buddy sat alone by the fire getting nervous — bear country, after all. He went to look. Found them. Quite a sight: the first guy bent over, the second shining a flashlight at his backside, and the third poking around in there. Turns out the first guy wiped himself with a newspaper — the one the fishing hooks were wrapped in.

— Why is there screaming from the operating room?
— The anesthesia hasn't kicked in yet, and the young surgeon...
— What, started cutting already?
— No. He said something you should absolutely never say in front of a patient.
— What did he say?
— "OK Google, which side is the appendix on?"

— Son, look: Dad has $700, Mom has $300. How much money does Mom have?
— $1000!
— That's right, son. That's right…

— What were you and the neighbor chatting about for so long?
— Oh, just... the weather.
— Listen up, Mr. Weatherman! See you near her one more time and you'll get heavy precipitation — no storm warning issued!

A guy pulls up home in a brand-new Jeep. His parents immediately demand: where did you get that?
— The lady down the street sold it to me for fifty bucks.
The parents rush over to find out what's going on.
— You see, — she explains, — my husband went on a business trip, then wrote saying he met someone else, he's staying there with her, and asked me to sell all his stuff and wire him the money.
— By the way, do you need a three-bedroom apartment? One hundred bucks.

— My husband just turned 50. We have a 20-year age gap between us.
— Oh, congratulations!
— For what?
— Well, for someone who's 70, you look absolutely wonderful!

A patient with appendicitis asks the surgeon before the operation:
— Doctor, will I be able to play the violin after surgery?
— You will.
— Are you sure?
— Absolutely, you will.
— What an operation! I never could before!

A man is waiting at the bus stop when a jogger runs by, flicks him on the nose, calls him an idiot, and keeps going. The next day, same thing: stop, jogger, flick, insult. That evening the man tells his wife. She says:
"Just ignore it — there are all kinds of weirdos out there."
The next morning he's back at the bus stop. The same jogger runs by, flicks his nose again and says:
"And you're a snitch too!"

— Why did Alex start stuttering after the wedding?
— Turns out his wife's mother is one of triplets. When he saw three mothers-in-law at the reception...

A stoner gets on a tram. An old lady asks him to punch her ticket. He takes it and turns to a man in uniform:
— Hey, soldier, punch the ticket!
— I'm not a soldier, I'm a sailor! — the man corrects him.
The stoner hands the ticket back to the old lady:
— Tough luck, grandma… No ticket needed — we're on a ship!

A son tells his parents:
"Mom, Dad, I'm an adult now and I want to live on my own."
"We're so proud of you, son! Oh, and your bags are already by the door."

— How did you manage to beat up the MP so badly — break his arms, legs, and jaw, stuff a wad of cash where the sun doesn't shine, and then strap a flashing siren to his head?
— I'd had a few drinks. You see, I asked him when they'd finally stop stealing public money and start caring about ordinary people. He told me: 'We've been stealing and we'll keep stealing — what are you going to do about it?' So I did what I could.

— Be honest, am I fat?
— Of course not! You're just very... noticeable.

— You've lost weight!
— Yes, I dropped a whole ten kilograms!
— Well, starting from 150... that's like a bolt falling off a tank.

A man showed up very late to work. His boss looks at him and asks: "Where have you been?" "I was seeing my mother-in-law off at the train station." "Fine. But why is your face covered in soot?" "Well, I was so overjoyed I kissed the locomotive!"

One day a boy brought his cow to the neighbor's bull for mating. While the bull was busy, the boy and girl sat watching. After a while the boy said:
— Hey, maybe we should give it a try too?
The girl shrugged:
— You decide. It's YOUR cow!

One old lady calls her friend:
— Come to my birthday party the day after tomorrow, in the evening! Who's coming? The whole usual crowd: Zoe the eye doctor, Mary the lawyer, Tanya the gynecologist, Irene the cardiologist, and Val the dentist.
— Should I bring my medical records?
— What medical records?
— From the clinic.
— Whatever for?
— Well, after the fourth drink I can get my whole check-up done in one go!

— Hey, do you play the trombone?
— No.
— What about your brother?
— Yes.
— Yes what?
— He doesn't either.

A guy takes a girl to a fancy restaurant. He orders a beer. She orders a hookah, seafood salad, salmon, and the most expensive cocktail. He thinks to himself: "Worth every penny — she'll definitely put out." He asks: "Do you always eat this much?" She, still chewing: "No, only during those days..."

They say there are many games in the world, but dad's are something else. One day dad suggested: 'Son, let's play the worm game!' — 'How does it work?' — 'A shovel split us in half: my half died on the couch, and yours picks up the toys and goes to bed.' It took me until I was twenty-five to finally figure out the trick.

I called my eight-year-old son over to the computer:
"Want me to show you your school on satellite? There it is — clear as day!"
He leaned in, studied it carefully, did some mental calculations... then asked with barely concealed hope:
"Dad, can you also strike it from the satellite?"

Husband to wife:
— Look at this! You took the big piece and left me the small one!
— And what would you have done?
— I would have taken the small one, of course…
— So what are you complaining about? That's exactly what I gave you!
A friend once told me: 'Stop being lazy — go to the Maldives!' Well... the only thing standing between me and the Maldives is my laziness.

Two mountaineers finally reached the summit of Everest. One of them, catching his breath, asks the other:
— So, did you end up taking that apartment swap?
— No way! Fifth floor with no elevator — do I look crazy to you?!

A man on the bus lets out a loud fart, then immediately nods toward the little boy next to him:
— Well, would you look at that — such a tiny kid, but sounds like an elephant!
A woman nearby speaks up:
— Excuse me, but that was YOU who did it!
— Can you believe her?! I'm covering for her, and she's pointing the finger at me!
After his mother-in-law's funeral, Pete was walking home. Suddenly a brick fell right in front of him from a rooftop. He looked up at the sky and quietly said: "Well, mom... I see you made it."

Spent the weekend at grandma's. She made my favourite chicken soup with dumplings. Grandma: 'Eat up, sweetheart, the chicken is fresh — I chopped one this morning.' Me: 'How did you pick which one?' Grandma: 'Well, I noticed one walking around looking sad, so I gave it the axe.' That's when I decided I'd never walk around looking sad at grandma's place…

Walking my daughter to kindergarten, she briefs me on the local gossip: "Diana's mom wants to gain weight." I sigh: "That's life — some want to gain weight, others want to lose it..." Then I think they probably talk about me there too, so I tell her: "Just don't say anything about me to anyone, okay?" She nods earnestly: "Sure, Mom. I won't tell anyone you want to lose weight. Let everyone think you just want to stay fat!"

A man walks into a pharmacy: "Give me something for greediness." The pharmacist looks puzzled: "Does such a thing even exist?" The man pulls a huge list of medications out of his pocket and says: "Look — it says right here: 'Take one tablet three times a day.' Could I get something cheaper that still works?"

On the subway, a guy was standing by the doors holding an iPhone 11 box. When the announcement 'Doors closing' came on, some dude snatched the box and vanished into the crowd. The doors shut, the train left. What the owner said next cracked everyone up: 'You bastard, they stole my hamster!'

— Hey, where would you rather be: by the sea or in the forest?
— At the sea, obviously! Are you booking us a vacation?!
— No, I'm just picking an air freshener for the bathroom...

— What do you want most right now?
— I want everything to be like it was before...
— For us to be together again?
— No. For me to have never known you existed!

***

— Describe your life in two words.
— What for?!

— Honey, what are you going to order?
— I want exactly what that woman at the next table is having: lobster, caviar, Peking duck, and a glass of wine.
— Perfect. I'll go ask her to dance, and you eat everything while she's gone.

Coming home after dinner at his mother-in-law's, the husband says to his wife:
— Why did you never tell me you have a sister?
— What sister?! I don't have any sister! What are you on about?
— Then who was your mom talking about all evening, going on about "my darling" and "my darling"?
What did our parents do to keep themselves entertained before the internet was invented? I asked my 11 brothers and sisters — none of them know either.

Grandma came to visit and sat down at the table, eating heartily. Her grandson ran up and asked:
— Grandma, who are you eating for?
— What do you mean, for myself, of course.
— That's odd... Dad said you eat for three.

A husband comes home and tells his wife:
— Honey, I've got two pieces of news — one good, one bad. Which first?
— The good one!
— I won a million in the lottery today!
— Wow, that's amazing! And the bad one?
— I told my best friend about it.
— So what's bad about that?
— He's coming tomorrow to borrow money.
